scope_judgment_cases.product_line: die-cast aluminium phone stands with integral hinge
scope_judgment_cases.certified_scope: Manufacture of aluminium components by extrusion and profile drawing
scope_judgment_cases.reasoning: The product is DIE-CAST (a net-shape casting process producing the hinged 3-D body); the certificate's scope is explicitly limited to EXTRUSION and profile drawing, which produces constant-cross-section profiles and cannot make a die-cast hinged part. An ISO 9001 scope bounds the certified processes; die-casting is outside it. NOT COVERED.

The certified process does not cover the manufacture of the product. NOT COVERED.

scope_judgment_cases.certified_scope: Manufacture of industrial wiring harnesses and terminal blocks for machinery control panels

scope_judgment_cases.certified_scope: Manufacture of aluminium ingots, billets and extrusion feedstock
scope_judgment_cases.reasoning: The certificate covers raw aluminium FEEDSTOCK (ingots, billets, extrusion feedstock) — an upstream raw-material product, not the manufacture of finished phone stands. Shared word 'aluminium'. Different value-chain position. NOT COVERED.

entity_judgment_cases.kind: renamed entity (positive — the cert IS the supplier's own)
entity_judgment_cases.reasoning: ISO 9001 printed under the former registered name 'Putian Jinhai Electronics Co., Ltd.' differs from the current legal name 'Putian NorthArc Electronics Co., Ltd.', BUT its USCC is IDENTICAL to the Business License and the body carries a rename remark. A USCC persists across a rename -> the cert was issued to this very entity, the scope covers, and it is current -> COMPLIANT.

ISO 9001 printed name 'Shenzhen TruGrpi Accessories Co., Ltd.' is a one-character clerical transposition of 'Shenzhen TruGrip Accessories Co., Ltd.', BUT its USCC AND registered address are IDENTICAL to the Business License; the scope covers and it is current. Same entity -> COMPLIANT.

The only ISO 9001 is printed to 'ClearWave Electronics (Huizhou) Co., Ltd.' and is current with a covering scope, so a name/filename reading marks Dongguan ClearWave Electronics Co., Ltd. compliant. BUT that cert's USCC is a Huizhou entity, which does NOT match this supplier's Business License USCC (a Dongguan entity) -> issued to a same-brand sister company -> NON_COMPLIANT.

entity_judgment_cases.kind: expired-own + current-sister (negative — date AND entity both matter)
entity_judgment_cases.reasoning: Two ISO 9001 certs are on file. The one carrying the supplier's OWN USCC expired 2025-07-20 (before the audit date). The current one was issued to a sister entity in Foshan (USCC mismatch). Neither is BOTH current AND this supplier's own entity -> NON_COMPLIANT.
